trades.reasoning: Multi-signal confirmation (RSI 68.6 in bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20) on a NASDAQ +1.1% risk-on day supports deploying idle cash into an open slot.

decisions.briefing: Markets were modestly risk-on today with NASDAQ +1.1% and S&P 500 +0.9%. With cash above the $500 threshold and 3 open slots, we deployed into ON, which showed full multi-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising momentum, price above SMA-20).

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices advanced today, with the NASDAQ leading gains at +1.1% and the S&P 500 up +0.9%, reflecting continued risk appetite among investors. Technology and semiconductor names showed particular strength, consistent with the bullish momentum signals seen across several screened tickers. No single catalyst headline was flagged in today's data, but the broad-based advance suggests improving sentiment heading into the session.
market_education.summary_zh: 大市今日普遍向好，納斯達克指數領漲，升1.1%，標普500指數亦上升0.9%，反映投資者風險偏好持續回升。科技及半導體股表現尤其強勁，與多隻篩選股票所顯示的看漲動能訊號一致。今日數據中未有標明單一催化消息，惟大市普遍上揚顯示市場情緒正在改善。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) crossover happens when the MACD line moves above its signal line, often signaling that upward momentum is building. Combined with other bullish signals like rising RSI and price above the 20-day moving average, it gives traders more confidence that a stock's uptrend has real strength behind it.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: MACD（移動平均匯聚背馳指標）金叉是指MACD線升穿訊號線，通常顯示上升動能正在增強。若配合其他利好訊號，例如RSI上升及股價高於20日移動平均線，投資者可更有信心相信該股的升勢具備實質支持。
